Embedding request via Ollama local provider with all-minilm model

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _request = try LiterLlm.embeddingRequestFromJson("{\"input\":\"The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog\",\"model\":\"ollama/all-minilm\"}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.embed(request: _request)
debugPrint(result.data)
debugPrint(result.data[0].embedding)
```
